source: LoG1 (USA) enemy templates 0x086B6094 (0x40 bytes each), decoded by re/log1/extract_enemies.py

units.exp_reward: added to player exp on kill
units.speed: SPEED_TABLE 0x080116A4 value in 1/16 px per frame (60 fps)
units.aggro_tiles: 8-px tiles, Manhattan distance for target acquisition; also wander radius
units.hurtbox: pixels relative to entity position (top-left of the 16x8 foot box), per facing

notes: Names come from the ROM template table (developer labels); sprite names from 0x080109F0. Labels and sprites disagree in places (sprite "trex" uses template "strong trex", sprite "burter" uses template "jeice", sprite "ginyu" uses template "burter", oozaru1/2 use template 6).
Boss actors are placed as NPCs and converted to enemies by scripts (0x0800573A / 0x0800DB00).

enemies.name: squirrel
enemies.move_type_desc: random wander within aggro_tiles (max 14) of current tile
enemies.target_type_desc: always flees from its target (0x0800F9AC)
enemies.drops: none (no drop code in the death path 0x08007F4C/0x08005E12; death only notifies scripts via 0x08005478)

enemies.name: snake
enemies.move_type_desc: random wander within aggro_tiles (max 14) of current tile
enemies.target_type_desc: opportunist: attacks only if the player is already engaged (player char+0x25C != 0), else flees
enemies.fight_style_desc: attack only if own HP > target HP, else flee
enemies.drops: none (no drop code in the death path 0x08007F4C/0x08005E12; death only notifies scripts via 0x08005478)

enemies.name: wolf
